label: MHI2Q_US_AUG22_P5145 MU1316
notes: The supplied 2020 SQ5 backup copied and byte-compared gal, libautoreceiver.so, lsd.jxe, smartphone_integrator.json and gal.json successfully.
libautoreceiver.so is byte-identical to the validated MU0918 receiver, so every receiver-side hook symbol and checked object offset is identical.
The MU1316 GAL executable has a reviewed firmware-specific safety fingerprint: CGALController::s_instance at 0x258580 and CVideoSinkImpl vtable at 0x251b28.
Its GAL dynamic symbol surface matches the reviewed MU1201 GAL except that MU1201 exports one additional unused ActiveObject constructor; the cluster video vtable has the same 196-byte shape.
The firmware-facing Java overlay compiles and passes all stock member/header gates and 162 host behavior assertions against the exact supplied MU1316 lsd.jxe-derived JARs.
This profile covers Android Auto cluster video, cockpit/HUD integration and steering-wheel controls; experimental external-amplifier upmix is excluded from the pilot.
Installation remains blocked in the public profile until one controlled on-car pilot confirms this unit's cockpit terminal/window behavior.
